d: Solar System colonisation and terraforming landscapes in Kim Stanley Robinson’s future histories.

mars.x: First settlement (Underhill) and the elevator tether city (Sheffield atop Pavonis Mons) chronicled across two centuries of planetary transformation.

phobos.x: Inner Martian moon transformed into an orbital transfer terminal and cable counterweight before its catastrophic de-orbiting in the 2061 revolution.

mercury.x: Vast city mounted on thermal-expansion tracks that rolls continuously around Mercury’s equator to stay inside the habitable twilight zone.

pluto.x: Enigmatic megalithic monument carved from water ice discovered at the north pole of Pluto, standing untouched for over a century.

b.s: Definitive hard sci-fi visions of planetary engineering, ecological politics, and human settlement across the Solar System.
b.r: Red Mars (1992), Green Mars (1993), Blue Mars (1996), 2312 (2012), Icehenge (1984)
